card.name: Inside all-caps warning phrases
card.fires_on: Partway through words in ALL-CAPS label warnings, such as PRE in PREVIOUS, INTER in DRUG INTERACTIONS, KE in SHAKE, and AND in a capitalized list. The next piece is expected to complete the capitalized word.

modes.label: Previous hypersensitivity warning
modes.description: PRE after 'HAS HAD' in the capitalized caution about prior hypersensitivity reactions before starting an antibiotic.
modes.example: CEFACLOR IS INSTITUTED, CAREFUL INQUIRY SHOULD BE MADE TO DETERMINE WHETHER THE PATIENT HAS HAD<< PRE>>VIOUS HYPERSENSITIVITY REA
